sourceMessages.text:
Multiple locations • Eats 
BEASTY • Dumplings 
New Category

sourceNotes: Dumplings already exists. Reuse it and append the chain after its seven earlier occupants. Existing Dim Sum occupants and all prior placements are retained.
Flats Burgers late request adds a Burgers overflow seat; its earlier four inline films and city seat stay fixed. New Nikki film plays on her existing page and Watch.
Five branch pages: four locations from the official website and the Foster City factory store explicitly listed on the supplied business profile. Each restaurant uses its own menu.
Icon quality is part of refetch intake. Original supplied and official assets are checked before release, at full size and phone tile size, with provenance retained.

researchSources.role: Owner location directory and branch contacts

artworkDispositions.disposition: Branch addresses and factory-store context; full private UI screenshot not republished.
Business email and general text number captured in branch contact panels.
Original supplied rainbow mark fitted to a 552 px square; phone margins removed. Monochrome owner PNG checked but supplied color artwork retained.
Late requested update; full wordmark retained with a larger fit and no screenshot border.
Full-resolution owner logo replaces the clipped/soft earlier profile crop. Alpha composited on white; complete Deli Board wordmark and sandwich preserved.

heldFacts: The factory store has no published current menu or hours in the supplied/official sources. It is a contact-only page.
2699 Taylor Street appears only in the Toast selector with ordering disabled, absent from the main owner directory and supplied profile. Active branch status is unconfirmed; no new page is asserted.
Millbrae phone differs between the main directory and Toast; both sources and their distinction are retained in the contact panel.
Branch menus exclude utensil/condiment packages and duplicate Popular Items sections; food and soft drinks remain.
